_comment: 山獅霸的多重宇宙 × 國小四年級資訊科技搞笑教學短片《甩一下跳五下？！micro:bit 跳繩智慧教練大作戰》。完全相容 make_film.py 與 cloud/colab_h3.py，正片 16 鏡 110.0 秒＋片尾 10.0 秒＝120.0 秒（整整 2 分鐘）。
title: 跳繩智慧教練
cine: A cinematic film still from a Taiwanese elementary school comedy movie, shot on Kodak Vision3 500T film with an anamorphic 50mm lens at f/2. Bright morning sunlight, warm side light with a soft glowing rim light on hair, warm amber and teal color grade, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. Full-frame image, NO black letterbox bars.
set_sentence: Use the location from <image{n}> as the set (same lighting, background architecture, and spatial layout), but only as the location.
frame_suffix: Only one main character in focus. No text, no watermark, no captions, no readable writing anywhere.

zhe.name: 阿哲
zhe.look: Azhe, a lively 10-year-old Taiwanese elementary schoolboy with a childish round face (clearly a young child, never a teenager), short messy black hair with a small cowlick on top, big expressive eyes, wearing a bright sky-blue and white Taiwanese elementary school sports polo shirt and navy-blue athletic shorts
zhe.voice_design: A lively 10-year-old Taiwanese boy with a bright, unbroken child's voice, energetic and cheeky, natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent.
zhe.voice_sample: 老師早安，我們今天體育課要練習八人跳大繩，這次我一定要帶大家跳超過二十下！

chen.name: 陳老師
chen.look: Ms. Chen, a Taiwanese female teacher in her mid-thirties with a gentle oval face, shoulder-length black hair tied in a neat low ponytail, thin gold-rimmed glasses, wearing a clean mint-green polo shirt, a silver whistle lanyard around her neck, and dark athletic trousers
chen.voice_design: A calm, composed Taiwanese woman in her mid-thirties, an experienced and patient teacher with dry humor, clear natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent.
chen.voice_sample: 各位同學早安，今天我們要用 micro:bit 做出一個跳繩智慧教練，幫大家穩定節奏跟計算次數。
chen.h3_voice: a calm, composed adult woman's voice

masters.playground: A cinematic wide film still, shot on Kodak Vision3 500T film with an anamorphic lens. A sunny Taiwanese elementary school outdoor red running track and playground in the morning, green trees and a colorful school building in the soft-focus background, a long cotton team jump rope with wooden handles lying on the track. Clean, uncluttered, realistic, warm morning sunlight. No people. No text, no watermark.
masters.lab: A cinematic wide film still, shot on Kodak Vision3 500T film with an anamorphic lens. Inside a bright modern Taiwanese elementary school computer lab classroom in the morning, neat wooden desks with computer monitors, large windows along the left wall letting in warm morning sunbeams, a blank green board at the front. Clean, uncluttered, realistic, warm amber color grade. No people. No text, no watermark.

line.text: 奇怪，今天操場的風怎麼吹得忽快忽慢？

shots.frame: Medium shot at eye level on the sunny school playground from <image2>: the boy from <image1> stands on the red track holding a wooden jump rope handle in both hands, panting with messy hair and an innocent, bewildered expression. Behind him out of focus, a tangled long jump rope lies on the ground. Sunlight comes from the left.
shots.action: The boy holds the jump rope handle, shrugs his shoulders with an innocent bewildered face, and makes his excuse.

line.text: 不是風亂吹，是你的手臂沒有裝節拍器。

shots.frame: Medium close-up at eye level on the school playground from <image2>: the woman from <image1> stands calmly, pushing up her gold-rimmed glasses with one finger while holding up a tiny black micro:bit circuit board with glowing red LED dots in her other hand, looking straight ahead with a composed deadpan expression.
shots.action: The teacher lowers her finger from her glasses, holds the tiny circuit board steady, and speaks with calm dry humor.

line.text: 這塊小板子連嘴巴都沒有，要怎麼幫我們數拍子？

shots.frame: Medium close-up inside the bright computer lab from <image2>: the boy from <image1> sits at a wooden computer desk, holding a tiny micro:bit circuit board close to his eyes, tilting his head with a skeptical, curious expression. Windows are on the left side.
shots.action: The boy tilts his head while examining the tiny circuit board in his hand and asks his question skeptically.

line.text: 它有點陣螢幕、按鈕、加速度計，還有蜂鳴器。開機先循序亮出笑臉，就是你的專屬教練。

shots.frame: Medium close-up inside the computer lab from <image2>: the woman from <image1> stands beside the teacher's desk, holding up a micro:bit board whose red 5x5 LED matrix displays a bright glowing smiley icon, pointing at the board gently with a warm confident expression.
shots.action: The teacher points at the glowing smiley LED matrix on the circuit board and explains clearly.

line.text: 再用重複無限次，每五百毫秒嗶一聲。固定一百拍，全班聽聲音起跳就絕對不會絆倒。

shots.frame: Medium shot inside the computer lab from <image2>: the woman from <image1> stands at the desk beside a micro:bit board connected to a small white battery pack, gesturing rhythmically with her hand like a metronome conductor, with a calm encouraging smile.
shots.action: The teacher marks a steady beat with her hand while explaining the rhythm loop.

line.text: 那誰來幫我們數跳了幾下？每次數到十幾下大家就開始吵架！

shots.frame: Medium close-up inside the computer lab from <image2>: the boy from <image1> sits at his desk with sparkling excited eyes, raising one hand eagerly while leaning forward.
shots.action: The boy leans forward eagerly with bright eyes and asks his question.

line.text: 交給加速度計和變數小盒子。開機把次數設為零，每當感應到晃動，盒子裡的次數就加一。

shots.frame: Medium close-up inside the computer lab from <image2>: the woman from <image1> holds a small clear acrylic storage box in one hand and a micro:bit board in the other, smiling warmly as she demonstrates putting a token into the box.
shots.action: The teacher holds up the small clear box and the circuit board, explaining the variable counter concept.

line.text: 報告老師！我練成閃電神功了！我才甩一下，螢幕直接跳到五耶！

shots.frame: Medium close-up on the sunny playground from <image2>: the boy from <image1> holds a jump rope handle with a micro:bit strapped to it, his eyes wide as saucers and mouth open in overjoyed shock as he stares at the glowing red LED screen in his hand.
shots.action: The boy stares at the glowing device in his hand in shock, then looks up and shouts excitedly with a proud grin.

line.text: 那叫做快樂表。你甩一下手腕回彈抖了五次，電腦太老實，零點一秒內幫你算了五下。

shots.frame: Close-up on the sunny playground from <image2>: the woman from <image1> pushes up her gold-rimmed glasses with one finger, looking straight ahead with an unimpressed, deadpan expression.
shots.action: The teacher lowers her hand from her glasses and delivers a deadpan explanation.

line.text: 蛤？連手抖都算喔！那怎麼辦，叫電腦不要看那麼仔細嗎？
line.tts: 蛤？連手抖都算喔！那怎[:ㄗㄣ3]麼辦，叫電腦不要看那麼仔細嗎？

shots.frame: Medium close-up on the sunny playground from <image2>: the boy from <image1> slumps his shoulders with a comical crestfallen, dramatic pouting face while holding the jump rope handle.
shots.action: The boy slumps his shoulders dramatically and asks with a funny troubled face.

line.text: 沒錯，加完一分，命令它暫停三百毫秒閉上眼睛休息，濾掉手抖雜訊，滿二十下再播歡呼音樂。

shots.frame: Medium shot inside the computer lab from <image2>: the woman from <image1> stands beside a computer monitor showing colorful coding blocks, raising one index finger with a clear, confident expression.
shots.action: The teacher explains the 300 millisecond pause solution with a reassuring smile.

line.text: 老師，那如果我設暫停三千毫秒，讓它睡久一點會更準嗎？

shots.frame: Medium close-up inside the computer lab from <image2>: the boy from <image1> tilts his head with a cheeky, overly clever grin, pointing one finger up as if he just had a genius idea.
shots.action: The boy grins cheekily and asks his clever question.

line.text: 三千毫秒是三秒鐘。你同學都跳六下了，你的教練還在睡午覺，只會幫你算一下。

shots.frame: Close-up inside the computer lab from <image2>: the woman from <image1> looks at the camera with the corner of her mouth curling into a small knowing, dry smile.
shots.action: The teacher answers with a calm knowing smile.

line.text: 可是老師，我一邊甩繩一邊低頭看握柄，眼睛快要脫窗了啦！

shots.frame: Medium shot on the sunny playground from <image2>: the boy from <image1> holds the jump rope handle right up against his nose, squinting cross-eyed at the tiny LED screen with a funny dizzy expression.
shots.action: The boy squints cross-eyed at the jump rope handle near his nose and complains comically.

line.text: 用無線廣播設同一個群組七。握柄用魔鬼氈和泡棉綁牢負責發送，場邊第二台當大看板接收。

shots.frame: Medium shot on the sunny playground from <image2>: the woman from <image1> holds a foam-padded jump rope handle with a Velcro-strapped micro:bit in one hand and a second micro:bit display unit in the other hand, smiling confidently.
shots.action: The teacher shows both the padded handle transmitter and the receiver unit clearly.

line.text: 二十下破紀錄啦！原來寫程式真的能當全班的跳繩神教練！

shots.frame: Medium wide shot on the sunny playground from <image2>: the boy from <image1> raises both arms in a triumphant cheer, holding the jump rope handle, while the glowing micro:bit display shows a bright red heart icon. Joyful celebratory atmosphere.
shots.action: The boy cheers joyfully with a huge smile, celebrating the team record.
